texts.zh:
在对[From.GetName]周围的残骸场进行细致扫描后，我们发现了一颗气密胶囊，里面有一只计时无比精确的原子钟。

它的频率不确定性低到需要再花八亿七千九百万年才会增加一秒，而且正在朝一个四十二年零三天后的日期倒计时。胶囊里没有记载这个日期代表着什么，或者其主人是谁。不过似乎有人失去时间概念了……
texts.en:
A closer scan of the debris field around [From.GetName] has led to the discovery of an airtight capsule containing an atomic clock that measures time with unparalleled precision.

It has a frequency uncertainty so low that it will be another 879 million years before it gains a single second and it is counting down to a date 42 years and 3 days away. The capsule holds no clues as to what this date signifies or who the owners are. But it seems as though someone out there has lost track of the time...

tooltips.zh: 胶囊里满是貌似无害的线路，任何一根都可能触发大规模毁灭性武器，摧毁整个星系！船员会将它们全都剪断！
tooltips.en: The capsule is full of innocent-looking wires, any one of which could be rigged to set off a weapon of mass destruction so potent that it would wipe out the entire galaxy! The crew will snip them all!!

texts.zh:
过去的42年零3天里，位于[Root.Capital.GetName]的研究人员一直怀着热烈的期望观察着我们在[From.From.From.GetName]发现的原子钟进行的倒计时。

几十年来的猜测与疑惑在瞬间烟消云散：随着原子钟倒数归零，他发射了一群可自我复制的纳米机器人！

根据计算，这群纳米机器人的抛物线对准的是[atomic_clock_planet.GetStarName]星系中的另一颗行星，[atomic_clock_planet.GetName]，预计将在一个月内抵达。

它们到达后将会发生什么，我们尚不得而知……
texts.en:
Researchers on [Root.Capital.GetName] have eagerly anticipated the countdown of the mysterious atomic clock of prodigious precision found on [From.From.From.GetName] for the past 42 years and 3 days.

Several decades' worth of heated speculation and conjecture have evaporated in an instant: the clock has just now reached its momentous deadline, ejecting a stream of self-replicating nanites!

These nanites are streaming on a trajectory towards another planet in the [atomic_clock_planet.GetStarName] System, [atomic_clock_planet.GetName], projected to arrive within the month.

Whatever may happen once they arrive remains to be seen...

label.zh: 有什么消息及时通知我们。
绝不能接受。对这群纳米机器人开火！

tooltips.zh: 命令我们处于该星系中的人手，摧毁从原子钟里出现的纳米机器人群。
tooltips.en: Order our crew in the system to destroy the nanite stream being emitted from the atomic clock.

texts.zh:
[atomic_clock_planet.GetStarName]星系小行星带中弹射而出的纳米机器人群，在[atomic_clock_planet.GetName]着陆了！这群纳米机器人以惊人速度迅速繁殖，只用了几个小时便覆盖了整颗行星的表面，并开始对其进行环境改造，将其转化为盖亚星球！

环境改造完成后几小时，所有参与改造纳米机器人全部自动关闭，并且腐烂至无法辨识的地步，直接导致我们无法从中提取任何信息与情报。

然而，它们的残留物为这个已经变得十分吸引人的星球表面增添了不少价值可观的金属合成物。
texts.en:
The nanite stream ejected by the atomic clock in the [atomic_clock_planet.GetStarName] system asteroid belt has made planetfall on [atomic_clock_planet.GetName]! Replicating at an incredible rate, the nanites covered the entire surface of the planet in a period of hours, proceeding to terraform it into a Gaia World!

Hours after the completion of the terraforming event, the nanites involved in the process deactivated and decayed beyond recognition, leaving us with little ability to extract any information from them.

However, their remains have peppered the surface of the now-very-tempting planet with valuable metallic composites.

据我们正在观察[atomic_clock_planet.GetStarName]星系的军官称，虽然大部分流向[atomic_clock_planet.GetName]的纳米机器人群已被炮火摧毁，却还是有数量难以统计的仍处于活跃状态纳米机器人到达了该行星表面。

它们的目的至今尚不明确，不过自从着陆后，它们就开始以一种似乎随机的方式开始了疾速繁殖。

[atomic_clock_planet.GetName]现在已被这种能够自我复制的显微级物质构成的粘液覆盖了。
texts.en:
Our military officers observing the [atomic_clock_planet.GetStarName] System report that while the vast majority of the nanites streaming towards [atomic_clock_planet.GetName] were fired upon and destroyed, an undetectable quantity of still-active nanites managed to reach the planet's surface.

Whatever purpose they were meant for remains unknown, but once reaching the planet's surface they have begun to replicate rapidly in a seemingly random fashion.

[atomic_clock_planet.GetName] is now covered in a moving slurry of microscopic replicators.

纳米机器人把这颗小行星变化成了一艘十分神奇的无人军事舰船，随后便离开了小行星的表面。

如果有兴趣，我们完全可以将其据为己有。
texts.en:

Several decades' worth of heated speculation and conjecture have evaporated in an instant: the clock has just now reached its momentous deadline, ejecting a stream of self-replicating nanites!

These nanites left the surface of the asteroid, where they have coalesced into a fascinating, unmanned military vessel.

It is ours for the taking, should we so desire.

纳米机器人在[From.From.From.GetName]表面建造了某种高级的计算网络。网络目前处于关闭状态，似乎也没有任何人工智能存在的迹象，而纳米机器人在建造完成后也都自动关闭了。

我们的研究人员对于这个网络的存在目的感到十分疑惑。要想研究这玩意，估计够让他们忙上好一阵了。
texts.en:
Researchers on [Root.Capital.GetName] have eagerly anticipated the countdown of the mysterious atomic clock of prodigious precision found on [From.From.From.GetName] for the past 42 years and 3 days.

Several decades' worth of heated speculation and conjecture have evaporated in an instant: the clock has just now reached its momentous deadline, ejecting a stream of self-replicating nanites!

The nanites have constructed some manner of advanced computational network on the surface of [From.From.From.GetName]. The network is inactive, and seemingly devoid of any AI, the nanites having deactivated the instant its construction was complete.

Our researchers are somewhat baffled as to the purpose of the network. Studying it should keep them occupied for quite some time.

现在几十年来的猜测与疑惑在瞬间烟消云散，同样消失的还有[nuked_primitive_planet.GetName]的大部分。

随着原子钟倒数归零，他向[nuked_primitive_planet.GetName]上的某个接收器发射了一个信号，触发了一场灾难性的热核爆炸，摧毁了整个行星和定居于此的原始文明。

在我们的科学家还在为这次精准定时的毁灭行为背后的缘由争论不休的时候，这台原子钟依旧在滴答作响，仿佛下方的荒凉死寂和它毫无关系一样。
texts.en:
For the past 42 years and 3 days, researchers on [Root.Capital.GetName] have eagerly anticipated the countdown of the mysterious atomic clock of prodigious precision, found on [From.From.From.GetName].

Now several decades' worth of heated speculation and conjecture have evaporated in an instant, along with most of [nuked_primitive_planet.GetName].

As the clock reached its momentous deadline it transmitted a signal to a receiver on [nuked_primitive_planet.GetName], triggering a thermonuclear explosion of such devastating power it laid waste to the entire planet and the primitive society residing there.

While our scientists debate the reason behind this carefully timed act of annihilation, the atomic clock continues to tick, undisturbed by the desolation below.

summary.text:
# 四十二年零三天 / 42 Years and 3 Days

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：《遥远繁星》Distant Stars（has_distar） · 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-12（已审阅 reviewed）
- 来源 Sources：common/anomalies/95_anomaly_categories_distant_stars.txt:1179-1219; events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:2129 (distar.1045); events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:225-310 (distar.310); events/distant_stars_events_2.txt:313-640 (distar.311-335)

## 如何开始 How it starts

需要《遥远繁星》。没有站点矿藏、且所在星系有前超光速文明星球（非环形世界）或未殖民的宜居星球时可能生成（3级，权重3，每个帝国一次）。卡片标题与“残骸场”相同。

Requires Distant Stars. Can spawn on a body without station deposits in a system that has a primitive (non-ringworld) planet or an uncolonised habitable planet (level 3, weight 3, once per empire). The card shares the title "Debris Field".

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. distar.1045“四十二年零三天”：残骸中的密封舱里有一台极精确的原子钟，正倒数42年零3天后的某个日期。注意观察 → 15323天（42年3天）后隐藏 distar.310 在当时满足条件的结果中等概率选一（各基础0，满足条件+1）；认定是炸弹拆掉 → 只有研究奖励。
2. 结果：distar.311 纳米机器人喷向星系内一颗不宜居星球——等待 → distar.312 星球被改造成盖亚世界；开火（星系内有我方舰船时）→ distar.313 漏网的纳米机器人把星球变成纳米之海。distar.315 纳米机器人组成一艘可接收的无人战舰（我方舰队可进入星系时）。distar.320 在原地建成计算网络。distar.330 信号引爆前超光速文明星球（核平）。distar.335 引爆一颗无人宜居星球。312、313、315 还提供L星团线索。

1. distar.1045 "42 Years and 3 Days": a sealed capsule holds an ultra-precise atomic clock counting down to a date 42 years and 3 days away. Keep an eye on it → after 15323 days the hidden distar.310 picks with equal chance among the outcomes valid then (each base 0, +1 if its condition holds); declare it a bomb and snip the wires → research reward only.
2. Outcomes: distar.311 nanites stream to an uninhabitable planet in the system — wait → distar.312 the planet is terraformed into a Gaia world; fire (if we have ships there) → distar.313 surviving nanites cover it in a nanite slurry. distar.315 the nanites build an unmanned warship we can take (if our fleets can access the system). distar.320 a computational network appears. distar.330 a signal nukes the primitive planet. distar.335 an empty habitable planet is nuked. 312, 313 and 315 also give an L-Cluster clue.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

distar.310 的五个结果互斥，权重取决于42年后星系的状况；distar.311 的等待/开火互斥。

distar.310's five outcomes are exclusive, weighted by the system's state 42 years later; distar.311's wait/fire are exclusive.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

distar.330 按排外/亲外有不同选项措辞。

distar.330 has xenophobe/xenophile wordings.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

已核对异常、distar.1045、310–335。树结构正确；补充结果权重说明。若帝国正在进行“L星团”事件链（l_cluster_chain，需《遥远繁星》），结果增加一条线索（共需7条）；集齐时触发 distar.10904“L星门见解汇集”（另一故事）。

Checked the anomaly, distar.1045 and 310–335. Tree correct; documented the outcome weighting. If the empire is running the L-Cluster event chain (l_cluster_chain, Distant Stars), the result adds one clue (7 needed); completing the count fires distar.10904 "L-Gate Insights Gathered" (a separate story).
